faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about how the portal works.

who.a: Institutions can register themselves. An administrator reviews each account before it can log in.

trust.q: What do the trust badges mean?
trust.a: Self-declared means only the institution has stated it. Document-verified means an officer checked it against the document. Bank-confirmed means a bank source confirmed it.

bank.a: Not yet. This prototype uses a simulated adapter and labels it clearly. It's built so a real bank API can replace it.

documents.a: Uploads are checked for type and size, encrypted before storage, and only available to authorised users.

tamper.a: Each audit entry includes a hash of the one before it. Changing an old entry breaks the chain, and the integrity check finds where.

language.q: Is the portal available in Hindi?
language.a: Yes. Use the language button in the top bar to switch between English and Hindi. Data entered by users stays as entered.

footer.about: A prototype for the centralised management of security deposits and Fixed Deposit Receipts.
footer.disclaimer: Smart India Hackathon 2026 prototype for problem statement SIH26265. Not an official AICTE website. All data shown is synthetic, and bank verification is simulated.
